title: The + menu closes with Escape or a click outside, with no change
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the Sales Representative field and click the + button.
  2. Press Escape.
  3. Click the + button again.
  4. Click on an empty part of the page outside the menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens below the + .
  • Step 2: the menu closes; the card still shows one "Sales Representative" field reading {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 3: the menu opens again.
  • Step 4: the menu closes; still one field reading {Sales-rep-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-R4, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R4: “Clicking the + opens a menu below it with one option, "Sales Representative - Parts". Clicking outside the menu or pressing Escape closes it without a change.”
